gamble on the weather: We decided to gamble on the weather and planned the picnic for Saturday without checking the forecast.
我們決定賭天氣，沒看氣象預報就把野餐訂在星期六。
gamble away one's savings: Within a year, he gambled away his savings at the casino and had to borrow money from his parents.
不到一年，他就在賭場賭光積蓄，只好向父母借錢。
gamble with lives: Companies that ignore safety rules gamble with lives just to save a little money on equipment.
忽視安全規定的公司只為了在設備上省一點錢就拿性命冒險。
take a gamble: He decided to take a gamble and quit his stable job to open his own small coffee shop.
他決定冒險一搏，辭掉穩定的工作，開一家自己的小咖啡店。
gang up on someone: The older kids used to gang up on him at recess, so his teacher finally stepped in to stop them.
年紀較大的孩子以前常在下課時聯手對付他，所以老師終於出面制止。
a gang of thieves: The police finally caught a gang of thieves who had broken into dozens of houses in our neighborhood.
警方終於逮到一夥竊賊，他們闖入了我們社區的幾十間房子。
gasp for breath: After running up ten floors of stairs, I had to stop and gasp for breath before I could speak.
跑了十層樓梯後，我得停下來喘氣才能說話。
gasp in surprise: When the magician made the huge elephant disappear, the whole audience began to gasp in surprise.
魔術師讓那頭巨大的大象消失時，全場觀眾都開始驚呼。
the last gasp: The old man used the last gasp of his breath to whisper his daughter's name to the nurse.
老人用最後一口氣向護士低聲說出女兒的名字。
gather information: Before writing her report, Amy spent two weeks at the library to gather information about climate change.
在寫報告之前，艾美花了兩週在圖書館蒐集有關氣候變遷的資訊。
gather speed: As the train left the station, it began to gather speed, and soon the city disappeared behind us.
火車離開車站後開始加速，城市很快就消失在我們身後。
gather strength: The storm is expected to gather strength over the warm ocean before it hits the coast on Friday.
預計暴風雨會在溫暖的海面上蓄積力量，然後在星期五侵襲海岸。
gather one's thoughts: Before answering the interviewer's difficult question, she paused for a moment to gather her thoughts.
在回答面試官的難題之前，她停頓了一下整理思緒。
I gather that: From the news I read this morning, I gather that the concert has been canceled because of the typhoon.
從我今天早上看的新聞，我聽說演唱會因為颱風取消了。
gather dust: I don't want my old guitar to just gather dust in the closet, so I'm giving it to my cousin.
我不想讓我的舊吉他放在衣櫃裡積灰閒置，所以要把它送給我表弟。
gauge public opinion: Before deciding on the new law, the government carried out a survey to gauge public opinion on the issue.
在決定新法之前，政府進行了一項調查來衡量民眾對這個議題的民意。
gauge the reaction: The company showed the new phone to a small group first to gauge the reaction of young users.
公司先把新手機給一小群人看，以評估年輕使用者的反應。
gauge the distance: In heavy fog, it is hard for drivers to gauge the distance between their car and the one in front.
在濃霧中，駕駛很難估算自己的車和前車之間的距離。
hard to gauge: Because the survey only asked fifty people, it is hard to gauge how most students really feel about the rule.
因為這份調查只問了五十個人，所以難以判斷大多數學生對這項規定的真正感受。
gaze at the stars: On clear summer nights, we would lie quietly on the grass and gaze at the stars for hours.
在晴朗的夏夜，我們會安靜地躺在草地上凝望星星好幾個小時。
gaze into the distance: She often sat by the window and would gaze into the distance, thinking about her family far away.
她常坐在窗邊凝視遠方，想念遠方的家人。
hold someone's gaze: He was so nervous that he couldn't hold her gaze and kept looking down at his shoes.
他緊張得無法與她對視，一直低頭看著自己的鞋子。
gear up for the exam: Many seniors are starting to gear up for the exam by forming study groups and staying late at the library.
許多高三生開始為考試做準備，組讀書會並在圖書館待到很晚。
be geared toward beginners: This yoga class is geared toward beginners, so you don't need any experience to join it.
這堂瑜伽課是針對初學者設計的，所以你不需要任何經驗就能參加。
gear the course to: The teacher tried to gear the course to the needs of students who had never studied Japanese before.
老師試著使課程適合從未學過日文的學生的需求。
change gear: When you drive up a steep hill, you need to change gear so that the engine doesn't work too hard.
開車上陡坡時，你需要換檔，這樣引擎才不會太吃力。
generate income: Many farmers now rent rooms to tourists to generate income during the months when there is no harvest.
許多農夫現在把房間租給遊客，以便在沒有收成的月份創造收入。
generate electricity: The new solar panels on the school roof can generate electricity for all the classrooms on sunny days.
學校屋頂的新太陽能板在晴天時可以為所有教室發電。
generate interest: The museum hopes the free dinosaur show will generate interest in science among young children.
博物館希望免費的恐龍展能引起小朋友對科學的興趣。
generate ideas: When you feel stuck, brainstorming with friends can help you generate ideas you would never think of alone.
當你卡住時，和朋友腦力激盪能幫你激發自己一個人絕對想不到的想法。
generate jobs: The new factory is expected to generate jobs for hundreds of local people who are out of work.
這座新工廠預計將為數百名失業的當地居民創造就業機會。
generate heat: Rubbing your hands together quickly will generate heat and keep your fingers warm on cold mornings.
快速搓手會產生熱，在寒冷的早晨讓你的手指保持溫暖。
